subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` grow a first-class cross-channel account/profile selector for provider-backed models, and what shared contract should Discord, Telegram, and future channel pickers implement?
rationale: The lower-level auth-profile machinery and typed `/model ...@profile` path exist, but picker presentation, persistence, compatibility with auth order, and cross-channel callback state are product and upgrade-policy decisions.

options.title: Define Shared Picker Contract
options.body: Add a shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channel pickers, including compatible profile lists, active-profile display, and focused regression proof.

options.title: Keep Typed Commands Only
options.body: Decide that `/model ...@profile`, `/model status`, and auth-order commands remain the supported account-switching path, then close or defer picker UX work.

options.title: Pilot One Channel First
options.body: Approve a narrower experiment in one channel while documenting that other channel pickers stay unchanged until a shared contract is accepted.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Picker Contract
recommendation.body: Add a shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channel pickers, including compatible profile lists, active-profile display, and focused regression proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the broadest current and historical footprint across shared model picker, plugin/channel migration, and auth-profile parsing/session override surfaces.
